Democrats urged to win midterms by 'massive numbers' to counter election denial

Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed has stated that Democrats must "win by massive numbers" in the upcoming federal midterm elections. He believes this is necessary because Donald Trump and his Republican allies are expected to "sow doubt about the integrity" of the elections, continuing Trump's unsubstantiated claims that his 2020 election loss was stolen.
